stories.title: Tech trailblazer helps small business tackle tasks with artificial intelligence
stories.simple_summary: A tech company is helping small business owners use artificial intelligence to handle repetitive tasks and get work done faster.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small business, this might help you save time on paperwork or customer emails without hiring more staff.

stories.title: Perplexity’s on-device AI offering promises data control and lower token costs
stories.simple_summary: A company called Perplexity is offering AI software that runs on your own device instead of sending your information to their servers, and it costs less to use.
stories.why_it_matters: If you care about keeping your business information private, this option gives you that choice.

stories.title: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding
stories.simple_summary: Stability AI, a company that makes software to create pictures from text descriptions, got $76 million in investment money.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
stories.simple_summary: Claude, an AI assistant, can now remember things you tell it across different conversations, so you don't have to explain your project over and over again.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude to help with your business, it will work faster because you won't waste time re-explaining yourself.
